summary: Iteration 3 focused on the new Bank Data admin feature set: (1) Admin CRUD (list/KPI/search/create/update/merge/delete), (2) Row-level auto-detect while editing an existing perangkat row (unambiguous auto-fill + ambiguous chip picker), and (3) Excel export + RBAC. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering list+KPI, search by prefix and by nama (case-insensitive), RBAC 403 for operator/guest on GET/POST/EXPORT, create validation (short/long prefix, empty nama), idempotent create, update nama, update-with-merge (merged=true and original row deleted), delete 404 on missing, and xlsx export (200 + correct content-type + PK-zip magic bytes). Frontend: /bank-data admin page renders with KPI cards (bank-kpi-entries/prefixes/namas), search box, add flow (bank-add-btn -> bank-add-prefix + bank-add-nama -> bank-add-confirm), edit flow (bank-edit-{id} -> bank-edit-nama -> bank-edit-save), delete cleanup (bank-delete-{id}), and Excel download (bank-export-xlsx yields bank-data-perangkat.xlsx). Row auto-detect verified inside PSB/INSTALASI WO -> Hasil Pekerjaan -> perangkat-add-btn draft -> row appears -> editing perangkat-nomor-0 to 'B2WS0100010305999' auto-fills nama to 'CANISTER 1.8 DIAMETER 4 INCHI'; ambiguous nomor 'B2WS020O011609999' shows 2 chips in perangkat-row-bank-options-0 (REMOTE HX50-IDU- C-BAND HUGHES + MODEM HX50) and clicking a chip sets the nama accordingly. All test entries cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3375 lines -- still recommended to split into modules (auth, workorders, invoices, perangkat, attachments).
perangkat_bank_update merge only copies count; if the collided doc has newer updated_at metadata (e.g. audit), no history is preserved -- acceptable for MVP but worth documenting.
Row-level auto-fill in PerangkatEditor only fills nama when curNama is empty or equals last auto-filled value (rowAutoRef). Good UX -- protects manual entries. Verified working.
GET /api/perangkat/bank uses estimated_document_count for total_entries KPI while count_documents is used for pagination total; slight discrepancy under heavy write load -- acceptable for KPI cards.
BankDataPage.jsx uses window.confirm for delete (non-shadcn); consistent with other admin pages but design system could get a confirm-dialog primitive.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 flows: bank CRUD+export, row auto-detect unambiguous, row auto-detect ambiguous)
